title: deckstack state document (durable part)
description: The single JSON state document owned by ds-daemon. Paths in docs/contracts/state.md map to this tree. Frames are never stored here, only references, and pushing a frame never mutates this document or bumps rev (S1): per-frame statistics live in the non-durable /telemetry tree. /bindings is an ARRAY of binding objects addressed by id (S2), because topics contain '/' and cannot be path segments.

rev.description: Global revision; bumped by every committed durable transaction. Frame pushes and telemetry sampling never bump it.

devices.description: Keyed by USB serial (read at connect, upstream/crates/mh-device/src/hub.rs:241-245).

controls.description: The complete control surface of the deck layout: keys, dial, knobs, faders, rollers — no other kind (the write path rejects unknown kinds).

keys.description: Key indices 0-14 only (15 keys on the screen module); '15', '99' and any other index are rejected at object level (S8 regression tests in tests/fixtures/).

knobs.description: Knob indices 0-2 only (3 knobs); any other index is rejected at object level (S8).

faders.description: Fader indices 0-4 only (5 faders); any other index is rejected at object level (S8).

rollers.description: Roller indices 0-1 only (2 rollers); any other index is rejected at object level (S8).

bindings.description: Array of binding objects (schemas/binding.json), each with a unique 'id' (e.g. 'b0001'). Addressed as /bindings/<id> or listed as /bindings. Topics contain '/', so they are NOT path segments (S2).

streams.description: Per-target stream CONFIG only (durable). Live stats are non-durable telemetry under /telemetry/streams (S1). Targets are the unified vocabulary keys | dial | key:<0-14> (S6); any other key is rejected at object level.

telemetry.description: NON-DURABLE, sampled at <= 1 Hz by the daemon. Reads of /telemetry/* never bump rev and carry no rev; subscription events on /telemetry/* carry "telemetry": true and no rev (S1). Never persisted to state.json.

streams.description: Non-durable per-target stream stats. Targets are the unified vocabulary keys | dial | key:<0-14> (S6); any other key is rejected at object level.

policy.description: Policy is data (D18, S13): every enforcement point has a schema field here, none exists only in prose. Writable only with admin scope; enforced at the daemon's single device-write/request choke points.

allow_hosts.description: Host glob list for mediated plugin network requests. '*' matches exactly one DNS label; matching is anchored against the full host. 'lights.lan' matches only lights.lan; '*.lan' matches lights.lan but NOT lan, a.b.lan, or lights.lan.evil.com (M5, S4).

roots.description: Absolute roots any client/plugin may reference with kind:file images or exec cwd (canonicalized, '..' rejected).

allow.description: Absolute binary paths exec steps may run (argv[0] must be in this list). Admin-managed.

deny.description: Absolute paths always refused even if also in allow — shells, interpreters and wrappers belong here by default: /bin/sh, /bin/bash, /bin/dash, /bin/zsh, /usr/bin/env, etc. (S3: 'no shell' is enforced, not asserted).

led_rate_per_s.description: Interim LED write cap pending soak test OPEN O2 (upstream/PROTOCOL.md:118-121).

focus.description: Ephemeral mirror of the last app/focus/changed event payload. Written by the router in the SAME transaction that dispatches bindings to it (S7), so 'when' conditions on /focus see the new value atomically.

visual.description: What a screen control shows. Frames are references, never bytes (ADR-005); a frame descriptor changes only when the SOURCE changes via a set op, never per pushed frame (S1).

path.description: Absolute path; the lookahead rejects any '..' segment (M3). The daemon additionally canonicalizes and confines to /policy/fs/roots at runtime.

brightness.description: Backlight 1-100; 0 is refused on the dial (upstream/PROTOCOL.md:61).

value.description: Device-reported fader position; written by the daemon from input events only.
